findings.description: AC-3/AC-4 name `app.bodyLimit`, which does not exist (RestApp has only jsonLimit, formLimit, multipart; no bodyLimit in main or docs). AC-4's docs test (every name exists on ServerOptions or RestApp) fails by construction.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace app.bodyLimit in requirement, AC-3, AC-4 with jsonLimit, formLimit and the app.multipart limits (maxFileSize, maxRequestSize, maxParts).

findings.description: AC-3 expects 413 for 'a body above the app body limit'; no generic body limit exists, only jsonLimit, formLimit and multipart limits, so the case is untestable. Requirement text also says 'body limit of the core'.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the generic body-limit clause; assert 413 for jsonLimit, formLimit and multipart maxRequestSize/maxFileSize/maxParts.

findings.description: AC-3/AC-5 (and FR-KT-002 AC-1, FR-KT-003 AC-1) scan packages by reflection; on the test classpath com.snoworca.naruserve also holds test classes, e.g. NullabilityFixture with @NonNull (verified CON-BUILD-011 AC-2), so AC-3 fails.
findings.suggested_fix: State that enumeration reads main classes only (naruserve.apiJar or build/classes/java/main), excluding test and testFixtures classes; same for FR-KT-002 and FR-KT-003.

findings.description: AC-1 says the dependency list equals the union of runtimeClasspath rows of dependency-graphs.txt, but those rows include the project's own com.snoworca.naruserve:* components (e.g. NaruServe-api, the module itself). FR-REL-004 AC-3 has the same mismatch with THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md.
findings.suggested_fix: Say rows with group com.snoworca.naruserve are excluded; com.snoworca.tinyhttpd components stay. Apply to FR-REL-002 AC-1/AC-4 and FR-REL-004 AC-1/AC-3.

findings.description: AC-4 says servlet.md Java examples 'compile against the module through the root docs compile test', but the root test classpath is NaruServe-api, gson and fixtures only; ServletConfigurer is absent there. It contradicts the same AC's 'absent type' skip entries.
findings.suggested_fix: Say the servlet.md Java blocks are skipped with reason `absent type ServletConfigurer` and compiled in a NaruServe-servlet test, or add the servlet module and javax API to the root testImplementation.

findings.description: AC-3 cites FR-ENGINE-001 AC-5, a discarded requirement (FR-ENGINE-001 -> FR-ENGINE-010 -> FR-ENGINE-011); Trace Links and text point at superseded ids.
findings.suggested_fix: Cite the live successor FR-ENGINE-011 for the boundPort IllegalStateException contract.

findings.description: AC-3 and Rationale cite OPS-ENGINE-001 AC-3, which is discarded (successor OPS-ENGINE-002, AC-3 restated).
findings.suggested_fix: Re-point to OPS-ENGINE-002 AC-3.

findings.description: These verified requirements keep depends_on CON-BUILD-003, now discarded by the CON-BUILD-017 supersede: dangling references.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-point the three depends_on links to CON-BUILD-017 (same relation), or record them as accepted historical links.

findings.description: AC-4 needs `./gradlew build --offline` to pass with a user home lacking both plugins, but CON-SVL-001 measures that jetty-servlet is not cached; checkDependencyRules records unresolved dependencies as violations, so an offline build without Jetty fails.
findings.suggested_fix: Require a user home that holds every default-build dependency (Jetty included) but neither release plugin.

findings.description: The lifecycle task releaseCheck is only named; the SRS never says what it depends on (releaseScan, releaseLicenses, releaseSbom) or whether it re-runs the scan, so AC-1..AC-4 do not fix its behaviour.
findings.suggested_fix: Define releaseCheck as dependsOn releaseScan and releaseLicenses (and what it reads: build report vs docs/release copy) in the requirement text.

findings.description: Vocabulary: `automated` means a test of ./gradlew build covers it, yet FR-REL-002 AC-3 and AC-3 here map a `completed` -Prelease scan to `automated`; and the unrun states are `manual-pending` (T50) vs `pending` (Java 8 row, scan report).
findings.suggested_fix: Map a completed release-machine run to `verified`; give SBOM and license lines explicit statuses; explain or unify pending vs manual-pending.

findings.description: AC-1/AC-2 run publishToMavenLocal and POM generation 'in a test' of the same build; a nested TestKit run on the real project (with includeBuild) contends for the build dir and .gradle locks of the outer build.
findings.suggested_fix: Generate POMs through generatePomFileForMavenPublication in the outer build and let the test read them via a system property, or run publish only in a recorded manual run.

findings.description: Rationale says release-tools Java sources are added to the root test source set and 'compiled and called' by gradle/release.gradle; a script applied at configuration time cannot call classes that are not yet compiled.
findings.suggested_fix: Specify how release.gradle runs them (own JavaExec/JavaCompile task or Groovy implementation) and that the unit tests compile in the default build.

findings.description: AC-5 requires raw `..`/encoded-slash lines to be answered `400` 'by container or core', but Jetty 9.4 normalises `..` before servlet mapping and may answer 404; 'never 2xx' and 'answered 400' differ.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert 'status 400, or 404 when the container never reaches the servlet, never 2xx' per case, and record each observed status in servlet.md.

findings.description: AC-3 says a body write in progress fails with IOException after abort(); the adapter cannot interrupt a write blocked in the container, which FR-SVL-006 AC-3 itself admits.
findings.suggested_fix: Reword: the next write, commit or finish after abort() throws IOException; a blocked write ends only by the container's write timeout.

findings.description: AC-3 negative fixture 'a compiled fixture class that calls kotlinx.coroutines.BuildersKt.runBlocking' needs kotlinx-coroutines on a test compile classpath, which the rule forbids on published modules and which adds a network dependency.
findings.suggested_fix: Generate the fixture class bytes (constant-pool string) in the test or write a class file by hand; no coroutines artifact in any configuration.

findings.description: AC-3 mandates the sentence that kotlin-stdlib is 'the only dependency of that module'; NaruServe-kotlin also depends on NaruServe-api, so the mandated doc text is false (kotlin.md now says it is the only module that depends on kotlin-stdlib).
findings.suggested_fix: Reword AC-3: kotlin-stdlib is used by this module only; the module otherwise depends on NaruServe-api.

findings.description: AC-4: defaults.md's existing paragraph under the pinned heading says the tuning is 'a manual follow-up of the release test'; the added sentence says it is not a manual-pending check, leaving two contradicting statements in one section.
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite the paragraph to post-v1 wording while keeping the tokens WaveSevenDocsTest pins (heading, `maxSseStreams`, `maxUpgradedConnections`, `sendQueueSize`, `수동 후속 작업`, `자동`).

findings.description: Trace Links 'extends CON-BUILD-017' (and OPS-REL-002 'extends OPS-HTTP-008') point at draft-by-supersede requirements; AC-5 says BuildLayoutTest is 'unchanged' while also re-pointing con_BUILD_003 tests and adding a check.
findings.suggested_fix: Use depends_on only toward stable requirements or accept same-wave links explicitly; reword AC-5 to 'assertions unchanged, citations re-pointed, one check added'.

findings.description: AC-2/AC-3 omit `naruserve.shutdownTimeoutSeconds` (range 1..300, default 10) and the statement that only Jetty 9.4 is exercised, both required by IR-SVL-001 AC-3/AC-5.
findings.suggested_fix: Add both to the docs AC and the keyword test.

findings.description: AC-2 finds table accessors 'by name'; `attribute` (void and generic overload) and `body` (Class and TypeRef) are overloaded, so name-only lookup is ambiguous.
findings.suggested_fix: Match by name plus the return-typed overload, or iterate all overloads that return a value.

findings.description: AC-1 does not restrict the inventory to interfaces declared in the public API packages (JDK single-method interfaces could match); AC-4 leaves 'generated resource or a shared list' open.
findings.suggested_fix: Restrict to com.snoworca.naruserve(.spi/.routing) interfaces and name the one mechanism.

findings.description: Existing Kotlin docs tests (JsonDocsKotlinTest, SseDocsKotlinTest, WebSocketDocsKotlinTest) carry no `// docs-example` markers, so they must be edited, while AC-5/IR-KT-002 AC-4 say JsonDocsKotlinTest 'stays untouched'.
findings.suggested_fix: Say only the test-local body() copy is untouched and markers are added to existing tests.

findings.description: Rationale says the CLAUDE.md root-build line gets an exception sentence, but no AC covers that edit or keeps the pinned `- 모듈:` line check.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an AC for the CLAUDE.md sentence and that BuildLayoutTest's module line assertions still pass.

findings.description: AC-2 reads the module jar like DefaultAppFactoryTest, but only :NaruServe and :NaruServe-api set a jar system property in build.gradle; Rationale cites RestApp.java:226-270 though the file ends at line 267.
findings.suggested_fix: Mention the new build.gradle test property for the servlet jar; correct the line range to 226-267.

findings.description: AC-3 forbids the strings cyclonedx/dependencycheck in 'any file of the root build'; the test itself and BuildLayoutTest sources would contain them, and the scope of 'root build' files is undefined.
findings.suggested_fix: List the files scanned (build.gradle, settings.gradle, gradle.properties) explicitly.
